shortDescription: Install fixes such as PTF, PTF Group, Technology refresh to the target IBM i system by image catalog.

options.name: apply_type
options.description: The fix apply type of the install to perform.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: fix_omit_list
options.description: The list of PTFs that will be omitted. The key of the dict should be the product ID of the fix that is omitted.

options.name: hiper_only
options.description: Whether or not only install the hiper fixes. Specify true if only need to install hiper fixes.

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to True.

options.name: product_id
options.description: The product ID of the fixes to be installed.

options.name: rollback
options.description: Whether or not rollback if there's failure during the installation of the fixes

options.name: src
options.description: The path on the target IBM i system where the fix installation file is located. The path is an IFS directory format.

options.name: use_temp_path
options.description: Whether or not to copy the installation file to a temp path. If true is chosen, it will copy the installation file to a temp path. The temp directory and the installation file copied to the temp directory will be both deleted after the task. It is recommended to use temp path to avoid conflicts. If false is chosen, the install will directly use the file specified in src option. The installation file will not be deleted after install if false is chosen.

options.name: virtual_image_name_list
options.description: The name list of the installation file.
